title: Low-Dimensional Flow-Regime Lens Contract (FRL-1)
description: A Lorenz-style 3-variable Navier-Stokes reduction read as a market regime lens: Jacobian fixed-point stability + the largest Lyapunov exponent classify laminar (stable fixed point, lambda<=0) vs turbulent (strange attractor, lambda>0). The Lyapunov sign must agree with the memory-mesh characterizer's taxonomy (chaotic<->turbulent, stable<->laminar). The market volatility cascade is mapped to the Kolmogorov turbulent energy cascade (multifractal/intermittency; Ghashghaie 1996; rough-vol H~=0.1). ANALOGUE / characterization only: 'scope' is pinned to analogue_characterization_only and any claim to solve or prove Navier-Stokes existence/smoothness is REJECTED.
